intro: OCBC Punggol is recorded in our project file as an OCBC workplace in JTC’s Punggol Digital District, at 98 Punggol Way. An OCBC release dated September 2024, as cited in the file, describes a 430,000 sq ft innovation hub over eight floors of a 12-storey mixed-use tower, with a 200-room hotel and retail, and a completion targeted in the first quarter of 2027. The file also notes that this is an owner-occupied office, not a multi-tenant lease-up, and that the date comes from a 2024 official release that was not reconfirmed in 2026. We therefore treat the first-quarter 2027 target as a recorded expectation, not as a date reconfirmed this year. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your OCBC Punggol fit-out.

sections.heading: Planning your OCBC Punggol interior
sections.text:
This page is not a home-renovation brief, and it is not a claim that Maison has an appointment on OCBC’s own floors. Owner-occupied workplace interiors are usually specified by the occupier. Where a separate hotel, retail or F&B operator later has its own unit in the mixed-use tower, the useful conversation with Maison is a shop or F&B fit-out: shopfront joinery, a counter, display and storage, and a back-of-house run, designed from that operator’s tenancy plan and permitted trade, not from the office floor plate. We will not invent a retail typologies list, a hotel interior, or a typical shop size, and no official plan is on file.

Matilda Riverside, packed earlier in Punggol, is a nearby HDB page and is not a workplace typologies reference. We will not invent walking times to Punggol Digital District or to any MRT station, and we will not treat a 2024 completion target as a confirmed 2027 opening day.

Operators who do secure a unit should work from their own lease, the landlord’s fit-out rules, and the approvals that the trade requires. A modest non-food shop fit-out is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals; that is an editorial allowance only. WhatsApp Maison with a tenancy plan if you have one. We are not affiliated with OCBC or JTC.

faq.a: Our file records a first-quarter 2027 target from a September 2024 OCBC release. That date was not reconfirmed in our 2026 file, so it is a recorded expectation only. The workplace is recorded as owner-occupied, not a lease-up.
